info.description: Administrative (not clinical) API for appointments, waiting lists, reminders and replies, transport and virtual-visit requests, analytics and tolerances. Every REST response is an `ApiResponse` envelope. Identity and workforce are held by person-service and worker-service; /api/patients and /api/practitioners proxy them. Request bodies and typed responses are not described yet (QUAL-4).
